stem: Root-zone EC rises over several irrigations while runoff volume falls. What is the best use of the EC trend?
choices: Treat it as a concentration and mass-balance signal to investigate with irrigation, moisture, runoff, crop demand, and nutrient context rather than as a universal proof of deficiency or toxicity.
Treat the EC value as a complete measure of plant nutritional sufficiency.
Ignore the trend because only nutrient-solution EC matters.
Conclude that every plant in the room has the same nutritional status.
rationale: EC describes dissolved-ion concentration and is most informative as a trend interpreted with water balance and system context; it is not a complete diagnosis of plant nutrition.
